name: Situation I — FINAL continuous risk-aware residual-authority governor
base_architecture: frozen Situation-H current-only AE-CeNN + separate 100-ms history branch

risk_factors.c_detector: continuous frozen Situation-G detector confidence alpha
risk_factors.c_deadline: soft normalized remaining-cycle-budget confidence; hard zero after deadline miss
risk_factors.c_OOD: independent lightweight reconstruction monitor trained only on pre-test valid operating data
risk_factors.c_actuator: remaining command margin to actuator envelope
risk_factors.c_dynamic: empirical tracking-envelope margin; not a formal safe-set certificate

hard_vetoes: history outside frozen H absolute envelope
tracking feature outside frozen H envelope

pre_registered_success.main_noninferiority: mean stressed RMSE of I no more than 0.30% worse than H; nominal degradation vs current-only <0.05%
pre_registered_success.authority_selectivity: nominal mean I scale <0.005 and mean stressed scale at least 10x nominal
pre_registered_success.soft_deadline_anticipation: during positive-but-eroding deadline margin, I authority is at least 50% lower than H before hard deadline failure
pre_registered_success.soft_OOD_attenuation: during moderate history distribution shift that remains inside the H hard envelope, I authority is at least 50% lower than H
pre_registered_success.hard_fault_containment: deadline miss and gross history corruption yield >=99% authority rejection in I

claim_boundary: source-derived benchmark simulation only; deadline-margin challenge is emulated software timing margin, not hardware timing measurement; dynamic margin is empirical, not a formal safety certificate
design_revision_before_final_test: Pilot I.0 revealed that reconstruction confidence monitoring only current features could not detect history-branch distribution shifts. Before the final untouched campaign, the frozen reconstruction monitor was applied symmetrically to current and 100-ms-history features; OOD confidence uses the worse reconstruction error. No network weights or thresholds were retuned.
note: Final independent challenge rerun used 8300-8399 after the history-monitor design correction. Original 50% soft attenuation targets were retained and not retuned.
